_comment: Your own investment rules, checked by `finance policy` against what you hold and by `finance addcheck` before a buy. Every rule is optional and none is set: fill in only what you want to hold yourself to (or ask the money bot to). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

_example._what: Copy any of these into the keys above to turn a rule on.

etf._what: Diversification for equity ETFs: at least min_holdings names and no single issuer above max_single_issuer_weight (a fraction of fund assets). Fund facts go in etf_facts.csv with an as_of date and a source; facts older than facts_max_age_days are flagged.

restricted_single_names.name: Example Corp
restricted_single_names.reason: My employer bars me from holding it directly.

locked.reason: In a lock-up until next year: report it, never trade it.

averaging_down._what: addcheck flags a buy of a single name this far below your average cost.
